intent.raw: Research and refine each missing point from the Triton Top2/CAP2 work using dispatch-spec, refine, subagent strategies, and full refine nodes.
intent.objective: Produce a full, non-executed refinement strategy that turns the remaining caveats into review-ready research, validation, paper, and artifact-inventory tasks.
intent.operator_sentence: research and refine each currently missing point; propose a route using subagents strategies and full refine strategy nodes

route_menu.context_hint: The implementation work-pack is complete-ready-for-review, but the remaining gaps are cross-cutting and need research, critique, and planning rather than immediate code mutation.

items.label: Full review hardening
items.description: Run the ten-stage Refine loop with role-bound subagent fanout for novelty, math, systems, baselines, paper, and artifact state.

items.label: Paper-only polish
items.description: Refine only the paper/package presentation without reopening technical research gaps.

items.label: Direct task sessions
items.description: Skip full refinement and immediately create task sessions for known gaps.

technique_overlays.trigger: The refine route must preserve the canonical ten-stage sequence.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every stage consumes prior evidence and preserves capability ownership.

technique_overlays.trigger: The remaining work could be paper-only, research-heavy, or direct task execution.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The selected route is recorded before any runtime-backed stage executes.

technique_overlays.trigger: The target has competing pressures: honest non-claims versus a strong challenge/paper presentation.
technique_overlays.convergence_criteria: Synthesis must keep only claims that have concrete path evidence and list unsupported ambitions as next work.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Final synthesis records supported claims, non-claims, and rejected overclaims.

technique_overlays.trigger: Entmax, exact-sparsity, dynamic-load, and benchmark scope create several possible next task boundaries.
technique_overlays.convergence_criteria: Rank next tasks by evidence gain, risk reduction, and paper impact.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Plan includes rejected alternatives and why the selected task order recomposes into review readiness.

technique_overlays.trigger: The paper/evidence package spans research tower, MARS paper files, RunPod receipts, formal proofs, and repository state.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Outputs include a component map of evidence roots, paper roots, validation roots, and dirty-worktree boundaries.

technique_overlays.trigger: Exact 2-sparsity and dynamic-load gradients can be probed with small fixtures before Triton work.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Plan names tiny fixtures and failure interpretation before expensive implementation.

technique_overlays.trigger: Prior sessions recorded glossary, proof, RunPod, and missing-point decisions that must not be lost.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Memory-derived facts are treated as context and checked against repository artifacts before promotion.

technique_overlays.trigger: Bounded external research may use provider, paper, or benchmark context that should not become canonical without review.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: External findings are cited and separated from local validated evidence.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The remaining gaps cut across prior art, formal math, GPU systems, benchmark design, paper claims, and repository artifact hygiene.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Parallel role-bound reviewers can inspect independent evidence surfaces and return receipts before Refine synthesizes the final plan.

roles.purpose: Research whether CAP2-v0 has plausible novelty and what prior-art comparisons are still missing.
roles.owns: CAP2 novelty gap; soft-rank/top-k prior-art comparison; novelty non-claim guard

roles.purpose: Refine exact 2-sparsity and dynamic-load-gradient questions into proof/test targets.
roles.owns: exact 2-sparsity gap; dynamic-load gradient gap; formal/numerical validation boundary

roles.purpose: Refine CAP2 zero-allocation, FP16 tolerance, benchmark scale, and RunPod reproducibility evidence.
roles.owns: CAP2 zero-allocation acceptance; benchmark scale; GPU evidence reproducibility

roles.purpose: Assess entmax and additional baseline coverage needed for stronger paper standing.
roles.owns: entmax implementation gap; baseline comparison matrix; candidate-kill criteria

roles.purpose: Map evidence to paper claims and identify presentation/polish tasks.
roles.owns: paper claim guards; evidence manifest completeness; appendix reproducibility

roles.purpose: Separate tower evidence, paper package, generated skill surfaces, and unrelated dirty worktree state.
roles.owns: artifact inventory; dirty worktree boundary; share/publish packaging risk

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Confirm to run the full review-hardening refine route with the six proposed subagents?

agents.residue: CAP2 novelty not established; keep candidate-only framing.
Exact 2-sparsity, dynamic-load gradients, and full CAP2 calculus remain scoped future work.
CAP2 needs dedicated zero-allocation, FP16, and broader benchmark acceptance before stronger systems claims.
Entmax and full convex sparse top-k router backward remain baseline gaps for novelty claims.
Paper needs claim-guard, reproducibility, theorem-to-claim, FP16, zero-allocation, and appendix polish.
Dirty parent worktree requires inclusion/exclusion manifest before commit or share.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: block if evidence roots cannot be separated into tower, paper, validation, and worktree-state surfaces

steps.name: Invoke Define
stop_conditions: block if the define stage cannot enumerate all eight missing points

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
convergence_criteria: Agree on which claims are supported now and which require new evidence.
stop_conditions: block if the critique permits unsupported novelty or production-performance claims

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: block external research if the operator does not confirm bounded research during execution

steps.name: Distill missing-point units
convergence_criteria: Each missing point becomes a smallest workable task or an explicit deferred non-claim.
stop_conditions: block if any proposed task lacks evidence owner, validation surface, or recomposition target

steps.name: Invoke Redefine / Design
stop_conditions: block if the design mixes paper polish with implementation mutations without an owner boundary

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
stop_conditions: block if unsupported claims survive the design review

steps.name: Distill Repair
stop_conditions: block if exact-sparsity or dynamic-load proposals cannot be tested first on tiny fixtures

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: block if the plan lacks acceptance checks for every selected next task

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: block if final synthesis does not separate ready-for-review, next tasks, non-claims, and artifact cleanup

gates.condition: Runtime-backed stages and subagents require explicit operator confirmation.
This route may propose tasks but must not directly promote CAP2 novelty, glossary, inventory, ontology, sigils, or paper claims.
Every missing point must end as supported, task-ready, deferred, or explicit non-claim.
Paper edits, kernel edits, evidence sync, and repository cleanup must remain separate next routes.
If subagents are spawned, each must have terminal join and close states or named residue/reroute.

boundaries.contract: Research tower evidence and paper package presentation are related but not the same owner surface.
Execution evidence cannot directly promote novelty, glossary, inventory, or paper claims.
External findings are protected context until cited and reconciled with local evidence.

state_namespaces.write_policy: read-only during proposal; mutations require approved downstream task
read-only during proposal; mutations require approved downstream task
proposal artifacts may be written here before confirmation

promotion_splits.target: canonical tower, paper, glossary, inventory, ontology, sigil, or spell knowledge
promotion_splits.rule: Subagent receipts are refine evidence only until an owner-approved downstream mutation promotes the claim.

promotion_guardrails: Do not claim CAP2 novelty without source-backed prior-art comparison and explicit novelty argument.
Do not claim exact hard Top2 differentiability.
Do not claim exact 2-sparsity for CAP2-v0 unless a new proof/test changes the evidence.
Do not claim dynamic-load gradients from fixed-load CAP2 validation.
Do not claim CAP2 zero-allocation W7 acceptance until measured as its own acceptance check.
Do not turn external research or memory-derived context into canonical knowledge without owner review.
